name: RSAWIT International Marathon 2026
short_description: The RSAWIT International Marathon 2026 is a full and half marathon event held on 22 November 2026 in Sibu, Sarawak, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The RSAWIT International Marathon 2026 takes place on 22 November 2026 in Sibu, Sarawak, Malaysia, starting and finishing at Dataran Tun Tuanku Bujang Phase 1 & 2 (Sibu Town Square). Runners can choose between a full marathon (42.195 km) and a half marathon (21.1 km). Registration is currently open for those interested in taking part.

faqs.question: When is the RSAWIT International Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The RSAWIT International Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on 22 November 2026. It is held in Sibu, Sarawak, Malaysia, at the Dataran Tun Tuanku Bujang Phase 1 & 2 venue, also known as Sibu Town Square, which serves as the event's starting point.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose between two distances at the RSAWIT International Marathon 2026: a full marathon covering 42.195 km, which is the primary distance for the event, and a half marathon option covering 21.1 km, suitable for runners preferring a shorter race.

faqs.question: Is registration still open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the RSAWIT International Marathon 2026 is currently listed as open. This means prospective participants can still sign up to take part in either the full marathon or half marathon distance ahead of the race date in November 2026.

faqs.question: Where does the race start and finish?
faqs.answer: The race is based at Dataran Tun Tuanku Bujang Phase 1 & 2, also referred to as Sibu Town Square, located in Sibu, Sarawak, Malaysia. This venue serves as the central hub for the marathon and half marathon events on race day.
